name: @rickylabs/harness-monorepo
description: Monorepo of DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin packages — the deterministic coordinator layer

scripts.build: node scripts/run-stages.mjs --label build --compile-stage build:packages check:stages check:graph check:lifecycle check:links check:forms check:snapshots check:compiled-policy build:packages check:publish check:label-registry check:docs check:skill check:tutorial
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run-stages.mjs --label typecheck --compile-stage typecheck:packages check:stages check:graph check:lifecycle typecheck:packages
scripts.test: node scripts/run-stages.mjs --label test check:stages check:test-scripts test:packages check:installed
scripts.skill:install: pnpm --filter @rickylabs/forge run build && node packages/forge/dist/cli.js skill install --dispatch-label harness
